question: Which of the following Universities secured the top place in the medal tally of the 'Khelo India University Games 2020'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab University**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Punjab University **secured top place in the "Khelo India University Games 2020" medal tally.
 
• It is Organized by the **Sports Authority of India **and the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sport.**
 
• It was the largest University level sports Competition of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **University Who won Gold Medal in Khelo India Youth Game 2020:__**

 
 
• ​Punjab University- 17.
 
• Savitribai Phule Pune University- 17.
 
• Punjabi University- 13.
 
• Maharshi Dayanand University- 11.
 
• Mangalore University- 9.
